etymologies.etymologyHTML: From staple (verb) +‎ -er.

definitions.definition: A device which binds together sheets of paper by driving a thin metal staple through the sheets and simultaneously folding over the ends of the staple against the back surface of the paper.

etymologies.etymologyHTML: From staple (noun) +‎ -er.

definitions.definition: (dated) One employed to sort wool according to its staple.
